critique: The render now has a convincing soft white smoke texture, centered horizontal composition, black background, and visible evolution between t1 and t4. It is closer to the intended preset, but the plume still visibly resolves into a small number of repeated bright columns: dark vertical seams divide the center, while the left and right ends form overly distinct bulbs. The thumbnail intent should read as one more continuously blended horizontal smoke stream rather than a segmented row of sprite clusters.

suggestions.why: Increase emission density so more overlapping sprite instances fill the dark vertical gaps and blend the bright lobes into a continuous plume.
Add more horizontal grid emission positions to reduce the obvious five-column source spacing that is creating the repeated segmented structure.
